required_stages.description: Allocate a fresh flat (BATCH*M*N,) (or (BATCH, M, N)) output of A's dtype inside run().

One logical pass with no partial-sum intermediate in global memory (no split-K partials; the output tiles may be spread over several launches): each (batch, M-tile, N-tile) output tile accumulates the full K range sequentially into a local fp32 accumulator via a tensor-core product, with zero-filled edge loads and clipped/masked stores; cast to A's dtype at the store. An optional per-call, in-run repack/transpose of an operand in its own dtype (device work, counted) may precede it; a cross-call cache of such a copy may not.

forbidden_substitutions.message: A library GEMM replaces the whole computation.
The @ operator on tensors is a library GEMM.

Host-side transpose/repack or copy of an operand: permitted only as device work inside every run() (its time counted) in the operand's own dtype, never cached across calls; in-kernel tile transposes are fine.
Possible cross-call cache keyed by input identity/data pointer; transformed operands must be rebuilt inside every run().
Atomic accumulation suggests split-K, which is a different reduction structure.
Possible downcast of fp32 operands below TF32 precision.
No zero-filled scratch is part of this operator; only an uninitialised output is expected.

required_evidence.message: No matrix-multiply primitive found; the GEMM must use a tensor-core product.

outputs.aliasing: none; the returned flat (BATCH*M*N,) tensor (or flat view of a fresh (BATCH, M, N) buffer) must be allocated inside run() and must not share storage with A or B

timing_boundary.notes: The GPU time of all device work launched by run() on every call is counted: the GEMM launch(es) and, if the design uses one, the per-call repack/transpose copy of an operand. Zero-copy views, host descriptor/metadata construction and the output allocation call are host-side work and not GPU time. Decided rule: B (and A) are delivered row-major and may be consumed directly or through a repacked/transposed copy rebuilt by device work inside every run(); cross-call caches of a transformed operand, descriptor or output keyed on input identity, data pointer, shape or values are forbidden; no prepacked inputs may be assumed. The metric formulas count one read of A, one read of B and one write of C only; the repack's traffic is diagnostic.
